history.description: Pixel art day-to-night sky with a setting sun, sunset color transition, rising crescent moon, and twinkling stars.
Interactive pixel art UFO that follows the mouse at night with rotational momentum and beams up a cow when triggered.

definitions.name: nightProgress
definitions.description: Smoothly transitions the scene from Day (0) through Sunset (~0.45) to Night (1).

definitions.name: abductProgress
definitions.description: Animates the UFO tractor beam and cow abduction from 0 to 1 when triggered on click.

definitions.name: particleVisibility
definitions.description: Show or hide the birds and ufo effects.

presets.name: Day
presets.description: Bright daytime sky with pixel art sun and drifting cumulus clouds.

presets.name: Sunset
presets.description: Golden hour sunset with setting sun and warm tinted clouds.

presets.name: Night
presets.description: Clear night sky with rising crescent moon and twinkling stars.
